manual_scope_assessment.public_types: CounterType is one uint32 definition shared by native OS and RTE headers; TimeInMicrosecondsType is uint64. Core count1 does not enable multicore. Wide service/configuration IDs never narrow before validation, capacity remains8. Typed ErrorHook IDs and original output pointers verified by actual callbacks.
manual_scope_assessment.ownership: ISR entry/exit under the existing native mutex saves/restores one of 32 bounded frames. Strictly increasing 1..31 priority prevents same-ID reentry. Task slots0..15 and ISR slots16..47 independently own resources. Native PE TLS holds Hook snapshots and logical masks.
manual_scope_assessment.priority_domains: All ISR levels exceed all Task levels. ISR-shared resource ceiling is in ISR domain and raises a holding Task to reserved kernel priority31; Task-only ceilings remain1..30. Saved native priority and interrupt ceiling restore independently in LIFO order.
manual_scope_assessment.hook_context: Hook-depth gate excludes Cat2 even during a nested Cat1. Error-active latch suppresses recursive reporting while a Cat1 is nested in ErrorHook. Typed snapshot resets on ISR entry and restores after child cleanup. Own logical mask cells remain separate.
manual_scope_assessment.call_graph: R17.2 Required remains unapproved: actual callback -> pend or critical exit -> Os_PortDispatchNested -> callback is bounded by strictly increasing configured priority, but is still indirect function reentry. Pre-existing public-wrapper/ErrorHook reentry also remains. Behavior and partial scans do not approve either deviation.
manual_scope_assessment.target_boundary: One existing native ISR actor, no allocation or new selector in nested dispatch. Foreign host producer enqueues under the existing mutex; controlled software pending and unmask boundaries model delivery, not physical asynchronous hardware latency.
manual_scope_assessment.coverage_limits: Cppcheck addon is partial and does not establish complete AMD1-AMD4/TC1-TC2 or all221 results; generated ECU and adopted source remain subject to final full assessment.
